name: Kıdem Tazminatı Hesaplama Aracı
author: veyselcicek

sections.description:
Kıdem Tazminatı Hesaplama Aracı (Severance Pay Calculator for Turkey) is a lightweight WordPress plugin that calculates severance pay according to Turkish Labor Law (İş Kanunu). Designed specifically for Turkish employers, employees, and law firms.

This plugin is intended for use in Turkey only. It uses Turkish tax brackets, minimum wage data, and severance pay ceiling values updated regularly according to Turkish regulations.

The calculation logic runs entirely on the server side (PHP). Visitors cannot access the calculation engine through the browser.

Free Version Features:

  • Severance pay calculation based on gross salary
  • Start and end date selection (up to December 31 of the current year)
  • Monthly additional income support (transportation, meal allowance, etc.)
  • Severance pay ceiling check (updated ceiling values for each period since 2020)
  • 5-year statute of limitations check
  • Mobile-friendly responsive design
  • Easy embed via shortcode: [kidem_hesapla]
  • 4 color themes (Dark Gray, Navy, Brown, Light Blue) — configurable from Settings

Pro Version Features:

  • Net-to-gross salary conversion
  • Notice pay (ihbar tazminatı) calculation
  • Income tax and stamp duty calculation
  • Total net compensation display
  • Print / Save as PDF

Upgrade to Pro: https://checkout.freemius.com/plugin/32848/plan/53930/
Support: veyselcicekler@gmail.com

Supported Tax Years: 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Select the zip file and click Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Add [kidem_hesapla] shortcode to any page or post
sections.faq:
Is this calculator accurate?

This tool is for informational purposes and produces estimated results based on Turkish labor law. For definitive results, please consult a labor law attorney.

Which country is this plugin designed for?

This plugin is designed exclusively for Turkey.

Which tax years are supported?

Tax brackets and severance pay ceiling values from 2021 through 2026 are included.

Can I calculate notice pay (ihbar tazminatı)?

Notice pay calculation is a Pro feature.

Can I enter my net salary instead of gross?

Net-to-gross salary conversion is a Pro feature.

What is the shortcode?

[kidem_hesapla]
